name: Form — MAS Human Gate
description: Native n8n 2.30.8 Form to inspect or answer Orchestrator human_gate. Loads status first and binds expected_version/gate_id automatically; engineer never copies CAS fields by hand.

parameters.formDescription: Resume a controlled engineering task that is waiting for human input. Enter the Task ID from Form — MAS Entry. Choose status to only inspect the gate, or reply/approve/reject to continue. For new wells you can attach WELLTRACK files and an xlsx with perforation MD + gas rates. Version and gate_id are loaded automatically.

values.placeholder: Answer the orchestrator questions in plain language. Required for reply; optional for approve/reject.
